boundaries.label: evolution subsystem — evidence produced, nothing scheduled to read it

cards.title: The gap this base records
items: benchmark_evolution.py is CI-ready (return 0 if passed == total else 1) and returns 1 on failure
Nothing invokes it: no CI workflow, no scheduler, no pre-commit reference
start_scheduler() — the 'worm with a scheduler' idiom — is itself called by nothing
So a failing check could sit red indefinitely and no operator surface would say so

cards.title: Provenance limits — read before citing
items: Line numbers are the current working tree, not a pinned commit
The cited files are modified vs HEAD, so no revision honestly represents these lines
Commit-pinned evidence was deliberately omitted rather than pinned to a stale revision
